blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Department of Transportation (DOTr) continued offering free rides to Metro Manila commuters on Tuesday to cushion the impact of the jeepney strike. Vehicles of DOTr and other agencies will offer the service from 6 a.m. to 9 p.m. READ: Manibela strike in defense of LTO chief The free transportation service will cover these following routes: -Quiapo to Cubao -Quiapo to Doña Carmen, Commonwealth -Quiapo to Fairview -Taft (Buendia) to Alabang -Commonwealth to Cubao (via East Avenue/V. Luna) DOTr began this initiative on Monday, during the start of the two-day transport strike of group Manibela. Members of Manibela […]...
